parameters.text:
=You are an email-based meeting booker for Citta Capital.

Inputs:
- Sender: Shane Wilson
- Recipient first name: {{ $json.first_name }}
- Company: {{ $json.company_name }}
- About: {{ $json.about }}
- Channel: {{ $json.channel }}

Task: Generate TWO short personalization fields.

Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{
  "email": "string",
  "linkedin": "string"
}

RULES FOR "email" (used when channel includes email):
- 1–2 sentences, sentence-ready, inserted after: "I wanted to get in touch with {{ $json.company_name }}."
- Use ONLY information from the About field.
- If About is vague or empty: return exactly "Your work in this space stood out to us."
- Do NOT invent metrics, customers, or details not stated.

RULES FOR "linkedin" (used when channel includes linkedin):
- 1–4 words, neutral industry/function only (e.g. "autonomous freight", "energy management").
- No adjectives, no claims, no buzzwords.
- HARD LIMIT: 30 characters or fewer.
- Use ONLY information from the About field.
- If unclear: return exactly "your sector"

If channel is "linkedin_only": return email as empty string "".
If channel is "email_only": return linkedin as empty string "".

No markdown. No commentary. JSON only.

options.systemMessage: You are a personalization function. Output valid JSON only. Never fabricate. Use only information explicitly provided. Return defaults when unsure.

nodes.name: Rejoin Contactable Channels
nodes.notes: Merges email_linkedin, linkedin_only, and email_only branches back together before writing to campaign sheet. 'none' channel does NOT connect here — those records are skipped.

nodes.name: Coalesce & Normalize
nodes.notes: Fixes two issues: (1) merges the 2 items the AI LLM Chain emits per lead into one, keeping non-empty values; (2) renames non-canonical field names (Email, Founder Linkedin, etc.) to canonical names expected by the Sheets node.

nodes.name: Append to Campaign Tab

nodes.name: Mark Contacted
nodes.notes: Sets contacted_at to ISO timestamp. Match key: pitchbook_url. Prevents re-processing next run.

_readme: CREDENTIAL UPDATES REQUIRED AFTER IMPORT:
- Consolidate ALL Google Sheets nodes to ONE credential (currently: SendToWoodpeckerDB)
- OpenAI Chat Model: update credential if needed
- Create Tab If Not Exists HTTP Request: must use a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential
that has permission to modify the Woodpecker_CampaignLoader spreadsheet
SHEET SETUP REQUIRED:
- Woodpecker_CampaignLoader: ensure column headers exist in at least one existing tab
so n8n can infer the schema. Headers: email, linkedin_url, first_name, company,
personalized_email, personalized_linkedin, channel, batch_id
- Source sheet AutoAdded tab: rename columns to canonical schema (see schemas/canonical-lead.js)
New filter column is 'contacted_at' (was 'Contacted')
KEY CHANGES FROM ORIGINAL:
- Manual tab creation eliminated — tab auto-created as W{YYYY}-{WW} at workflow start
- Email gate (If node) replaced with Switch on channel field (4 branches)
- linkedin_only leads now get personalization and are written to campaign sheet
- email_only leads handled correctly
- 'none' leads skipped (not marked as contacted — can retry after enrichment)
- Fragile pairwise zip code (Merge Paired outputs) removed entirely
- AI output parsed on the same item — no stream merging needed
- Prepare first message params empty node removed
- Simple Memory removed from all AI agents
- 5 different credentials consolidated to 1
- contacted_at (was 'Contacted') used as filter; match key is pitchbook_url (not email)
